# filmopen_mcp

*Generated by `scripts/package_digest.py`; regenerate, never edit.*

The MCP server for FilmOpen (the MCP Specification). It is a Dart command-line program that an agent's MCP client spawns, and it drives a running FilmOpen agent build through Flutter's driver extension. The MCP library (`dart_mcp`) lives here and nowhere in the app.

**Flutter.** 7 files, 2,219 lines under `lib/`; 98 tests in 7 files. Barrel: `lib/filmopen_mcp.dart`.

## Depends on

- **filmopen_automation (dev)** — uses nothing by name the digest could see

Third-party: dart_mcp, stream_channel, vm_service, flutter_driver.

## Used by

No package of FilmOpen.

- **class `AppLink`** — The server's line to one running FilmOpen.
  - `Future<String> requestData(String message)` — Sends one message on the data channel and answers the app's reply.
  - `Future<Uint8List> screenshot()` — A PNG of the app's whole view as Flutter rendered it.
  - `Future<void> waitIdle()` — Waits until the app has no animation running.
  - `Future<void> enterText(String text)` — Types [text] into the box that has the focus, replacing what it holds, through the driver's own text entry.
  - `Future<void> close()` — Closes the connection; the app goes on running.
- **variable** `const String kDriverExtension` — The name the driver extension answers to in an agent build's isolate.
- **class `DriverLink`** — The [AppLink] of a running agent build: Flutter's own driver, handed a connection this link made itself.
  - `DriverLink(this._driver, {this.requestTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 45)})`
  - `static Future<DriverLink> connect(String vmServiceUrl, { Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 10), Duration requestTimeout = const Duration(s…` — Connects to the agent build whose VM service answers at [vmServiceUrl].
  - `final Duration requestTimeout` — The longest a request waits for its reply.
- **function** `bool isLocalServiceUrl(String url)` — Whether [url] is a VM service URL on this machine: `http` on the loopback, the only place an app's service listens.
- **class `ServiceUnreachable`** — What a connection meets when nothing answers at a VM service URL: no app, or an app that has gone.
  - `const ServiceUnreachable()`
- **class `NotAnAgentBuild`** — What a connection meets when a service answers but none of its isolates carries the driver extension.
  - `const NotAnAgentBuild()`
- **function** `Uri serviceWebSocketUri(String vmServiceUrl)` — The WebSocket address of a VM service URL, as the driver derives it (`vmservice_driver.dart`).
- **function** `Future<void> probeService(String vmServiceUrl, {Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 5)})` — Opens and closes one WebSocket to the VM service at [vmServiceUrl].
- **function** `Future<bool> serviceGone(String vmServiceUrl, {Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 30)})` — Waits until the VM service at [vmServiceUrl] stops answering, probing every half second for at most [timeout].

### `lib/src/launch_lock.dart`

- **class `LaunchLock`** — The one build a checkout makes at a time (§4.3): `flutter run` builds into the checkout's own `build/` folder, so a second launch while the first builds would build into the bundle the first is about to run.
  - `LaunchLock(String repositoryRoot, {this.stale = const Duration(minutes: 10), DateTime Function()? now})` — The lock of the checkout at [repositoryRoot].
  - `final File file` — The file that says a launch is building.
  - `final Duration stale` — How old a lock may be before it is taken for one a launch left behind.
  - `Future<bool> acquire({ Duration within = const Duration(minutes: 5), Duration every = const Duration(seconds: 1), bool Function()? stopped, })` — Takes the lock, waiting at most [within] while another launch holds it; answers whether it waited.
  - `void release()` — Lets the lock go, where it is still this launch's.
